The '''Austan Asteroid Cluster''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]. It was the site of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations and resorts.<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of a [[Skirmish at the Austan Cluster|skirmish]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CWA">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>
